title: 28 April 1947 — The States Enter the Assembly
summary: Representatives of Indian States enter the Assembly; the President accelerates the constitution-making timetable, Nehru reports the States negotiations, State seats are added to the Steering Committee and the Union-subject report is held for later reconsideration.

title: Indian States Enter the Constituent Assembly
summary: State representatives present credentials, explain why they have joined and contest the idea that princely-State participation is separate from the making of an Indian Union.

title: Transfer of Power Changes the Drafting Clock
summary: Rajendra Prasad links Britain's announced June 1948 transfer deadline to an accelerated sequence of committee reports, principle-setting and drafting.

title: States Representation — Elected or Nominated?
summary: Somnath Lahiri asks how the attending States representatives were selected; the President records that eleven were elected and five nominated.

title: Union Subjects Report Remains Provisional
summary: Gopalaswami Ayyangar presents the Union-subject report but postpones debate because League participation, States representation and impending political decisions may alter the federal framework.
